## Agent Execution — runs ONE agent through OpenRouter
Input (POST JSON): {project_id, task_id, agent_id, task_description, input_context, models?}
Output: the unified schema {task_id, project_id, agent_id, status, output, error, artifacts, usage}.

**Setup:** API keys come from the n8n environment variables GROQ_API_KEY / OLLAMA_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY (set them in the .env file next to docker-compose.yml) — keys are NEVER stored in this JSON. Default provider, per-agent models & prompts live in the **Resolve Agent Config** code node — edit them there.
